description: Every 30 minutes on weekdays, looks in each AP client's Xero for new draft or awaiting-approval bills that Hubdoc, Dext or a person put there, reads the PDF attached to each one with AI, and adds one AP bill row per bill so the agent can check it against the PDF and the client's coding. It changes nothing in Xero. Bills the agent itself entered from email are skipped.
